subject: c6k f204 root cause = ASTC_4x4_LDR app snapshots refused by the translator profile; fix + HEAVY TAKE gates
body: f204 is MTLPixelFormatASTC_4x4_LDR (1125x2436: SpringBoard app snapshots). rc=-6 is the Rust planner refusing: 'Unsupported { feature: Format, needs VK_FORMAT_ASTC_4x4_UNORM_BLOCK SampledImage }' (16x TEGU_GENERIC_DRAW_REFUSED in the log). n2t/planner already implement ASTC LDR/sRGB 2D (generic_astc_2d_format, n2t ASTC plane); only the translator feature-ceiling profile (desktop RTX 5080 vulkaninfo) lacks ASTC. Fix (mine, build plumbing touched minimally): metal/tegu/build_compute_bundle.py astc_ldr_profile() adds textureCompressionASTC_LDR + VK_FORMAT_ASTC_{4x4..12x12}_{UNORM,SRGB}_BLOCK sampled/linear to the profile; tools/build_tegu_frontend_objects.sh applies it after framebuffer_fetch_profile. Host: fsjobs replay with fb_img = 1125x2436 format 204 -> old profile reproduces the exact device refusal (16x rc=-6, invalid frame), new profile: 0 refusals, all frames status 4. NOTE: the profile is in every pipeline-cache key -> packs/disk caches rebuild once. A/B disables: PREFRAME (phase 3) and NATIVE_INDEXED=0 (phase 7) were both this ASTC refusal (indexed_expand hits it too), not the features; ASYNC_PIPELINE (phase 9): no record because TEGU_COMMAND_FAILED is capped at 16/process and was exhausted - the lines before are TEGU_FRONTEND UNSUPPORTED iosurface_target_capability (95x, texture-creation refusals, not command failures), so most likely the same ASTC class. SpringBoard 'first=nord2_render_pass:84': a 4x MSAA attachment with resolve refused because the pass took its sample count from defaultRasterSampleCount (1); fixed in nord2_render_pass.inc (sample count from the first owned colour attachment, then the existing MSAA class checks). Running gates now.
